techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 1

Point is the Nominatim result for the phase, which lands beside the Wipro EC cluster.

techParks.name: Wipro SEZ Sarjapur

techParks.name: TCS Think Campus
techParks.description: TCS's owned Bengaluru campus (No. 42, Electronics City Phase II) and its principal delivery centre in the city. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: HCL Technologies SEZ Jigani
techParks.description: HCLTech's owned SEZ campus (No. 129) in the Jigani industrial area at the southern edge of the metro, its largest Bengaluru site. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: 360 Business Park
techParks.description: New Grade A office park in Electronic City Phase 1 where TCS leased ~1.4 msf (Towers 5A and 5B) for 15 years in August 2025, with phased occupation from April and August 2026. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: International Tech Park Bangalore

Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: Bagmane Tech Park

Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: Bagmane World Technology Center

techParks.name: L&T Tech Park

coverageNotes: Method: WebSearch budget for the run was exhausted after the first 24 queries, so most verification came from company contact/locations pages fetched directly, two PDFs (TCS's 2023 ISO annexure and Wipro's FY2016-17 office list) read locally, the OSM office/park extracts, and Nominatim/Photon geocoding. Confirmed from the company's own page: Wipro (5 current sites), Tech Mahindra, LTTS, Tata Elxsi, Coforge, Hexaware, Birlasoft, Zensar, Mastek (SEBI filing), Sonata, Happiest Minds, Brillio, Quest Global, Infinite, Sasken, Subex, Tejas, Tally, Quess, TeamLease, Kyndryl, Firstsource, Ramco, Sapiens, Thoughtworks, Persistent, Sify, Cyient DLM. Infosys, HCLTech, Mphasis, LTIMindtree, Cyient and Mphasis rest on directories/filings plus OSM (their locations pages returned 403/404/503). LEFT OUT for lack of any verifiable Bengaluru address: UST, Kellton, Nucleus Software (its own site lists no Bengaluru office), 3i Infotech, Aptean, Nagarro, GlobalLogic, Endava. NOT CONFIRMED and therefore omitted: TCS at Deccan Park or Bagmane; Tech Mahindra at Bagmane/Whitefield; LTIMindtree at Bagmane; HCLTech at GR Tech Park and its Quest Informatics subsidiary office in Rajajinagar; Mphasis at AMR Tech Park/Electronic City; a Tata Elxsi Hosur Road HQ (its own page gives ITPB Road, Whitefield); Wipro's older MG Road, Bannerghatta Road (Solitaire), Divyasree Technopark and Pritech Park units (2016-17 list only); Infosys BPM, Manipal Centre and the other leased Electronics City sites in Infosys's 2017 filing; Quess House on Sarjapur Road and Quest Global's Ecospace unit (older OSM POIs, likely vacated); Firstsource's Pritech Park Campus 5B (old OSM POI). Low-confidence entries are OSM-only (DXC, NTT DATA, Globant, EPAM, Encora, HGS, Mindteck, one HCLTech and one Tech Mahindra office) and are labelled as such. Several coordinates are park- or locality-level rather than the building (geocodeSource park-centroid / Nominatim locality) and carry medium or low confidence: Happiest Minds HQ (Madivala), Quess Tower, TeamLease (Infinix Square), Brillio's The Hub, Zensar's Shilpa Ananya, LTTS Vista Pixel, Mphasis Mascot, Wipro EC5, HCLTech PB Softtech. Category rule applied mechanically: listed Indian companies above ~10,000 staff (Cyient, Persistent, Coforge, Hexaware, Birlasoft, Firstsource, HGS, Quess) are MNC; Zensar (~10,000) was kept MID_SIZE. Brillio is Foreign (Edison, NJ HQ) and Quest Global Foreign (Singapore-registered) despite Indian origins; Infinite is Indian because its own site calls Whitefield its Head Office. Encora is recorded as a separate company with a note that encora.com now redirects to coforge.com; merge with Coforge if the integration is complete. TCS's 360 Business Park lease is marked planned because phased occupation (April/August 2026) could not be confirmed as of October 2026.
